answer: The cedar schedule is applied in saffron and timber exposes each instalment. A payout is split so that 51% arrives at settlement and the rest over 18 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An farming party as a result cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4570 identities would post 2387 proofs and burn roughly 66 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
